positive.prompt: Set up a GitHub Actions pipeline that runs the Flutter tests on every pull request
Add a release stage to the pipeline that signs the app and uploads it to TestFlight
Automate the quality gates so nothing merges without passing checks

negative.prompt: Refactor this function so it is easier to read

evals.prompt: Create a CI pipeline for this Flutter app: install dependencies, check formatting, analyze, test on every PR, and block merge on failure.
evals.expected_output: A working workflow definition with correct triggers, steps, and failure behavior
expectations: The workflow triggers on pull requests
Failure of any quality gate (format, analyze, test) fails the pipeline run
Steps are ordered logically: dependencies, then format/analyze, then tests, and the Flutter SDK setup and caching are sane
The Flutter SDK version is pinned or read from the project rather than floating
No secrets are hardcoded in the workflow
